jobs.title: HR Manager Benelux - People Operations
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global leader in virtual care, with over 100 million users and more than 500 million annual healthcare interactions. We offer the only comprehensive virtual care solution that encompasses telemedicine, mental health, wellbeing, specialist medical advice and platform services.

Our Amsterdam team is growing. We are strengthening and scaling our local People Operations to create a consistent, employee-focused HR foundation for our continued growth in the Netherlands.

Role:

A hands-on, high-execution role at the heart of our people’s function.

This position plays a key role in running day-to-day HR operations while contributing to Teladoc Health's people strategy in Amsterdam as we scale.

Teladoc Health is looking for a hands-on HR Manager to take ownership of People Operations in the Netherlands. In this broad and autonomous role, you will ensure that our HR operations, recruitment and employee processes run smoothly, while acting as a trusted people partner to the Country Manager and local Management Team.

You will be the primary HR contact for employees in the Netherlands and work closely with colleagues in our regional and global People & Culture organization. Your initial focus will be on operational excellence, Dutch employment-law compliance, recruitment and employee experience. As the local HR foundation develops, you will also contribute to workforce planning, organizational development and other strategic people priorities.

Responsibilities:

Own end-to-end HR operations: contracts, onboarding, offboarding, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and employee records
Act as the first point of contact for employees on all people-related questions, from day-one logistics to day-to-day issues
Advise the Country Manager and local Management Team on people, organization and employment matters.
Ensure full compliance with Dutch labor law and internal policies, keeping documentation and processes audit-ready
Manage recruitment end to end for open roles, from job description to offer, as the main person driving the process
Build and continuously improve onboarding so new joiners ramp up quickly and feel at home fast
Take full ownership of HR processes day to day, prioritizing operational excellence and consistent execution over ad-hoc fixes
Identify gaps in current HR processes and implement practical, scalable improvements
Maintain accurate HR systems, trackers, and reporting so leadership always has an up-to-date picture of the team
Translate global People policies into effective local practices and identify where adaptation to Dutch requirements is needed.
Contribute to strategic people topics as they arise, including workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and org design input, while keeping operational delivery as the day-to-day priority

About You!

Experience:

At least five years of broad HR experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for HR operations in the Netherlands.
Sound working knowledge of Dutch employment law and local HR practices.
Experience with employee relations, absence management, payroll coordination and end-to-end recruitment.
Experience in an international, fast-growing, startup or scale-up environment is an advantage.

Languages:

Professional fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Digital skills:

Strong digital proficiency, including experience with HRIS, payroll interfaces, reporting tools and Microsoft 365.

Soft skills:

Essential: high execution power, approachable and easy-going manners, pragmatism, clear communication, with strong judgement, ownership, discretion, the ability to set priorities independently, and eagerness to grow with the company

Education requirements:

Minimum studies: relevant degree or equivalent professional experience in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

Compensations & Benefits:

The gross monthly salary for this role ranges from EUR 5,750 to EUR 7,000 based on a 40-hour working week, excluding 8% holiday allowance. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s relevant experience and fit with the scope of the role. In addition, we offer pension contribution, travel allowance, Teladoc Academy and a hybrid working arrangement.

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
Planned Systems International (PSI) is an Enterprise IT services company who focuses on designing, building, securing, and operating cutting-edge software solutions that drive mission success and operational excellence for Federal Government organizations. We are currently seeking a Human Resources Manager to perform HR related duties on a professional level and works closely with the HR Team and Senior Management.

The HR Manager position is responsible for managing day-to-day HR operations, supervising HR personnel, leading HR initiatives and projects, and partnering with leaders to support business objectives and will serve as the primary Human Resources partner for the assigned value segments as well as corporate, providing both strategic guidance and hands-on HR support throughout the employee lifecycle.

The HR Manager oversees employee relations, performance management, compliance, employee engagement, workforce analytics, and HR administration while ensuring exceptional service and compliance with company policies and applicable employment laws.

Essential Functions And Job Responsibilities

Leadership & Personnel Management:

Serve as the primary HR partner for assigned value segments and corporate, providing strategic guidance and day-to-day HR support.
Lead and develop assigned HR personnel through coaching, mentoring, performance management, and accountability to build a high-performing Human Resources function.
Partner with executives and managers to resolve complex workforce issues and support organizational objectives.
Lead HR projects and process improvements while preparing executive reports, presentations, and recommendations.

Employee Relations & Performance Management:

Manage employee relations matters, workplace investigations, conflict resolution, corrective actions, and performance improvement plans.
Oversee performance management and annual evaluation cycles for assigned value segments, ensuring consistency, compliance, and timely completion.
Coach leaders on employee performance, development, documentation, and employment-related decisions.

HR Operations:

Manage the day-to-day HR operations for assigned value segment, including offboarding, compensation changes, employee transactions, international processes, leave administration, and policy interpretation.
Maintain employee records and ensure the integrity of HR systems, including UKG Pro, iCIMS, and SharePoint.
Provide timely guidance and support to employees and managers on HR policies, procedures, and employment matters.

Compliance:

Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and government contracting employment regulations and company policies.
Manage required compliance reporting, audits, policy administration, and employment law guidance while minimizing organizational risk.
Prepare and analyze HR reports for Finance to support compliance, budgeting, forecasting, and workforce planning.

Employee Engagement & Workforce Analytics:

Oversee employee engagement initiatives, survey administration, action planning, and follow-up.
Develop and analyze HR metrics and workforce analytics to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and support business decisions.

General Responsibilities:

Manage multiple priorities independently while maintaining confidentiality and exercising sound judgment.
Serve as the strategic liaison between Human Resources and Talent Acquisition, ensuring alignment of hiring strategies, workforce planning, and organizational priorities.
Perform additional Human Resources duties and special projects as assigned.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of twelve (12) years of progressive Human Resources experience across all major HR disciplines.
Minimum of four (4) years of experience managing Human Resources personnel.
Extensive Human Resources experience supporting federal government contractors is required, including employment law, OFCCP, Affirmative Action, Service Contract Act (SCA), and related compliance requirements.
Demonstrated experience managing employee relations, workplace investigations, performance management, compliance, and HR projects.
Experience with employee engagement platforms, workforce analytics, succession planning, and leadership development.
UKG Pro, iCIMS, and SharePoint proficiency.
Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Desired Qualifications

Master's degree in Human Resources , Business Administration, or a related field.

Company Benefits

PSI offers full-time, benefits eligible employees a competitive total compensation package that includes paid leave, and options for employer sponsored group medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, AD&D coverage, legal services, identity theft, and accident insurance. Flexible spending account and health saving account options offer pre-tax savings for qualified medical, dental, and vision expenses. The company sponsored 401(k) retirement plan has an employer contribution match that is immediately vested. We invest in the professional growth of our employees through professional courses, certifications, and tuition reimbursement programs.

EEO Commitment

It is company policy to promote equal employment opportunities. All personnel decisions, including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination, are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, citizenship status, veteran status, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities will be provided. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources by emailing HRDepartment@plan-sys.com , or by dialing 703-575-8400.
